requirements.description: Reference-like coherent pixel clusters, rooted tree contacts, connected natural path and banks; scene retains guide crossing and root positions, without correcting gameplay geometry to match drift.
Original scene appearance survives separation. Actor reads on deck, in front of and behind a tree. Ground-only view retains root beds and banks without tree ghosts.
Actual keyboard/touch traversal across the bridge and back; tree and water block movement; destination reachable.
Observed complete water cycle/wrap inside a fixed channel, stationary banks and pause freezes motion.

comparisons.focus: Consistent native pixel treatment, shared root beds and organic path/water boundaries. Small forest composition, not exact reference replication.
Same material style and actor readability at playing scale.
Retain route/crossing/root positions while replacing neutral forms; separate correctly registered original-image layers and retain natural ground connections.
